title: KeygateOfflineLicenseToken
description: Schema for the offline-verifiable license entitlement token payload and signed wire format in the Keygate ecosystem.

kid.description: Public key identifier for the server signing key used to sign this token.

sts.description: License status at the time of token issuance.

did.description: Bound client device identifier (e.g. kgid:v1:platform:hex or UUID).

ftr.description: Entitlements and feature flags granted to this license installation.

iat.description: Issuance timestamp as a Unix epoch second.

exp.description: Offline token expiration timestamp as a Unix epoch second. The maximum offline window after which the client must check in.

vun.description: License term expiration timestamp as a Unix epoch second. Zero or omitted means perpetual license.

upd.description: Perpetual license maintenance cutoff timestamp as a Unix epoch second. Releases published after this date cannot be installed.

grc.description: Number of grace days allowed after vun before offline client halts execution.

nce.description: Cryptographically random nonce to ensure uniqueness per token issuance and prevent token replay.

fpr.description: 16-hex character (8-byte truncated SHA-256) device-product binding fingerprint.
